ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures that MPI communication defaults to the TCP network fabric,
# which is compatible with container networking, and avoids issues with
# shared-memory transports (vader) or high-performance interconnects (openib)
# that are typically not available in standard cloud container environments.
# Also, allow oversubscription by default, which is common in CI/CD or development.
# Note: The user will still need to add `--allow-run-as-root` to the mpirun command.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1

# Combine installation, build, and cleanup into a single RUN layer.
# This minimizes the final image size by removing build dependencies and caches.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    cmake \
    build-essential \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libfftw3-dev \
    libgomp1 \
    # FIX: Install Python 3, which is a required dependency for the LAMMPS CMake build process.
    python3 && \
    \
    # FIX: Clone the latest development branch by omitting the '-b stable' flag.
    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git /opt/lammps-src && \
    cd /opt/lammps-src && \
    \
    # Configure and build LAMMPS from source using CMake.
    # We enable the required REAXFF package and ensure MPI support is built.
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -D BUILD_MPI=on \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
      -D PKG_KSPACE=on && \
    \
    # Compile using all available processor cores for a faster build.
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    \
    # Copy the main LAMMPS executable to a standard location on the system PATH.
    # This makes 'lmp' directly available to users and scripts.
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/ && \
    \
    # Set up the working directory and populate it with example files.
    mkdir -p /app && \
    cp /opt/lammps-src/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    \
    # Clean up to reduce final image size.
    # Remove the source code and build-time dependencies that are not needed at runtime.
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /opt/lammps-src && \

    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Users can run the application with a command such as:
# mpirun -np <num_procs> --allow-run-as-root lmp -in <input_script>
